create_weak_ref_tensor: create a weak reference to a single torch.Tensor using the sgl_kernel or torch_npu backend
create_weak_ref_tensors: create weak references to a list, tuple, or single torch.Tensor in one call
test_weak_ref_tensor_single: test weak_ref_tensor with a single torch.Tensor on CUDA or NPU
test_weak_ref_tensors_list: test weak_ref_tensors with a list of torch.Tensor objects
test_weak_ref_tensors_tuple: test weak_ref_tensors with a tuple of torch.Tensor objects
